title: Welcome to AVOLI — our work begins
excerpt: Who we are, why we exist, and the programmes ahead.
body: The Akinwale Vincent Omoniyi Legacy Initiative (AVOLI) exists to impact lives, create opportunities for young people, equip people with relevant skills, support vulnerable people and build stronger communities. Follow our training announcements, food-bank outreaches and partnership news here.

title: Volunteers needed: trainers, media & outreach
excerpt: Join our founding volunteer team across Lagos and online.
body: We are recruiting volunteer trainers (HSE, digital, employability), content creators, and Saturday outreach volunteers. Visit Get Involved → Volunteer to apply.
